summary.en: Having been found by the scoundrels, Iori had no choice but to defeat them like other scoundrels. However, one of them managed to flee away from being subdued by the PSB officers later on and swore to make Iori pay one day. The story returns to the present where Iori still hasn’t found the USB yet, as the butler return to the body to finally notice how the victim hid it so well that the blackmailer couldn’t find in the first place, Heiji comes with message from Conan, hinting that they have acknowledged about the situation.
